lines: The Falling Feather: two rings now raise Fuse Arrow's skill panel number too (the second burst was only counted against the enemy). Two rings add up: x2.0 with two 50% rings (checked in game).

Arrow Totem with Trap: the skill is a totem, not a trap. Trap Support's own damage still counts, but Trap lines from the tree, Oaths and gear (Hidden Edge, Oath of the Snare, Oath of the Hidden Wire) no longer do (checked in game: crit and damage match).
Skill panel DPS now includes Crack for skills that deal Cold damage, as the game's own tooltip does (checked in game).

Conversion: a skill's own conversion (Fuse Arrow, Lightning Arrow and other elemental attacks) now happens first, then Ice, Zap and other conversion lines convert what is left. Passive tree conversion (Hoarfrost Temper) now converts every damage type like a support. Element splits now match the game (checked on Fuse Arrow and Lightning Arrow, patch 91).
Bina's Spotter's Helm: ramp up to 25% (patch 91).
Spell Echo on a Spell Totem: the note now says the game's panel counts the echoes too (checked in game).
FAQ: the Entropy card shows monster chaos resistance at Rupture 100, 160 and 200, and at Riven Tiers.
Skill Scaling: "How to make it stronger" on each card is now folded; click it to open.

Minions now get half of every damage engine line, not only the defence ones: Boundless Mind's Intelligence line, Oath of Many Fires' mana line, cast speed, item Oaths and Bloodlust. Half for the defence lines and for Boundless Mind is checked in game; the rest follow the same rule.
Pyre Spark: its more damage per 100 life is the Grave Golem's own multiplier, not part of the damage engine (checked in game: x1.374 on the golem with 2,875 life; the sim had x1.354).
Skill Scaling: every skill card has a "How to make it stronger" list (which damage lines, attribute, speed, cooldown, crit and ailments raise it), read from the sim's own rules.
Added damage on attacks now uses each attack's own effectiveness (for example Wheeling Axe 60%, Leap Slam 150%). Leap Slam's hit now matches the game exactly (checked in game).
Strength block: the 2% / 4% / 6% block at 100 / 200 / 300 Strength is counted.
Unique lines with tiny saved rolls are no longer rounded wrongly (for example The Patient Bastion).

The skill panel's Ignite number now includes crits, as the game's own tooltip does (patch 90): Pyre of Faith, Consecrated Ground and Orbiting Hammers panels now sit within 0.2% of the game (were about 2% under). Damage against enemies is unchanged: ailments still don't take crit.
Orbiting Hammers: a note says the hit rate is counted for an enemy right next to you; from farther away the ring hits less often (checked in game: about 95% touching, about 75% at 3.7 m).
Anvil of Heaven: checked in game. It bursts on every 6th hit for the part of the hit that strikes; with the Chaos support the burst lays no Entropy.

New Advanced tab in the Build Planner: every number behind your build (speed, crits, hit damage, enemy, mana, attributes, life, energy shield, armour, evasion, resistances, max hit). Hover a dotted row to see which lines make it up.
Advanced replaces Damage Analysis: Damage Composition, DPS Scaling and the modifier lists and notes are there now. Top Optimization Suggestions moved to the Character tab, under the Potions belt.
The site has its own tab icon (the LILSHRIMPER sigil).
Rain of Bolts: the Ballista splash now counts against a single target (checked in game).
Golem blessings: Intelligence's minion bonus is counted once, not twice (checked in game).
Vows: an idol's +1 count line (+1 Ballista, Spark, Chain ...) is no longer offered as a Vow.
Far Shot, Point Blank, Hunter's Mark, Sigil Surge and Arcane Overflow no longer count for skills placed by Spell Totem or Arrow Totem, as their texts say.
Dragonling tree: clicking a node away from your path takes it with the shortest path.
Skill tree tooltips: totem lines that add nothing say why, and a few repeated or -0% lines are fixed.
FAQ: new Entropy card under Ailments.
Skill tree tooltips: Venom Mark and the other "for each Fury / Mark / Ignite" lines the sim counts are no longer listed under "Not in the DPS number".
Skill tree tooltips: when taking a node costs several points, the tooltip names the nodes on the way, since its value counts them too. Thanks for the report.

Vows on red items: since patch 90 the game changes a Vow when the red item already has the same kind of line (a Cast Speed Vow on Cinderwick, which has its own Cast Speed, becomes Cooldown Recovery when you log in). The Add a Vow lists and Optimize this item no longer offer such Vows, and one already on an item now says which line the game turns it into. Thanks for the report.
Optimize tree and Plan tree now also try every Dragonling Aspect and recommend the best one; the switch shows each Aspect's gain, and Apply and Undo set it.
Dragonling tree: hover an Aspect to see what it does; the Aspect is now picked with buttons, each showing what switching to it does to your DPS.
Dragonling tree: every node shows its DPS gain (in its tooltip and as heat map colours), with a Best next picks list you can click to take.
Dragonling tree: the mouse wheel now changes the Dragon Ruptures box.
Optimize tree, Plan tree and Plan next points now spend your Dragonling points too (Plan Dragonling box, on by default). The Aspect you picked is kept.
Database: New first sits on its own row and looks clearly different when on. Clicking the category you already picked goes back to All.

Eyrie Watch (Dragonling, Stormwing): Ballistas last 60% longer, multiplied with your other duration lines, as the game shows. A longer life raises the Bina's Spotter's Helm ramp. Its "placing one at your maximum refreshes them all" did not happen in a game test, so it is not counted.
Gear Set Sim: each changed slot has an Equip button, so you can take one piece at a time and keep the result on screen.
Skill tree tooltips: lines the sim does count (more mana, speed and totem lines, ignite stacks and others) are no longer listed under "Not in the DPS number".

Bina's Spotter's Helm: the 2% more per shot in a row is now counted per Ballista and starts again for every new Ballista, as a test in the game showed. The sim averages it over a Ballista's life, so totem duration and totem speed raise it (attack speed does not). It was a flat 50% more; most builds now get between about 20% and 45%.
With The Unfallen Ancestor your Ballistas never expire, so the helm's ramp counts the full 50%.

Rime Sprites, Cinder Mites and Brass Sentinels now count "+1 to maximum number of minions" lines (like the Core Touched minion amulets): one more companion and 3% more damage of its element each, as the game shows.
Translations: the Market, Vows and Riven Atlas tabs, the newer Item Simulator options, the Damage tab stats panel and the FAQ card on ailment damage are now in all ten page languages.
Patch 90: critical strikes no longer make Bleeding, Ignite or Poison bigger (the game's patch notes). Hits still crit; the ailment numbers drop for crit builds.
Patch 90: a Guardian's freeze bar is now 20% of its life every time (it was 12%, each next bar 50% bigger), so freeze-based helpers and Frostbreak count more Brittle windows.
Patch 90: increased Vow effect from gear and the tree now adds to the Vow's own bonus instead of multiplying it, as the game does now.

Passive tree: Oath of the Pyre, Oath of the Long Night, One Breath, Hammer of Judgement and 9 other nodes no longer show their bursts and sky swords under "Not in the DPS number": the sim counts them (the last update meant to do this but missed).
